cohort: The study included 157 traditional market traders from three North Sumatran regencies (Deli Serdang, Serdang Bedagai, and Langkat) in Indonesia.
finding: Postpartum visits were identified as the most influential determinant of exclusive breastfeeding among traditional market traders.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was identified as one of the significant determinants influencing exclusive breastfeeding.
